name: Ineffable Enigma
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [language-dependent, mind-affecting]; Level oracle 2

EFFECT

Duration concentration

DESCRIPTION

You reveal to the target horrific secrets mortals were not meant to know. As lesser confusion.
